status: Exploratory criteria defined after training began and initial results were examined; not preregistered
criteria_application: Apply the same accuracy and storage criteria to each run; summarize all seed passes jointly. Report every failed run and full continuous results, without excluding failures from inference.
all_seeds_pass_interpretation: All observed seeds passed; this does not establish that all future seeds will pass.
accuracy_degradation_vs_dense: No additional relative degradation margin; absolute nu error threshold applies
compression_verification: Exact tensor reconstruction and identical tested predictions
storage_scope: Final inference files including weights, biases, raw_nu, indices and metadata; optimizer and training data excluded. File storage savings do not imply GPU RAM savings.
angle_equivalence_status: User-approved exploratory equivalence margin; inference must control planned multiple comparisons
target_power_status: Planning target, not certified achieved power
